flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code for this feature in the six repos. Close but not this feature: ocmsadminprivateapi cron-schedules-prod.properties (cron list, no weekly job to DOS; only tempblobcleanup is weekly at lines 320-323), framework/workflows/agencies/lta/download (daily LTA/ROV results for notices in processing), framework/services/datahive (per-notice NRIC/FIN/UEN lookup). ocmsadminui: the Tagged Vehicle page and its menu are commented out (App.tsx:43, 326-329; LinkData.tsx:406)
note: Status blank (epic ERP2, 'Logic/flow not received'). No code was found that selects tagged vehicles/IDs by life status, sends them weekly, or compares ownership. grep for 'tagged', 'hitlist', 'life status', 'ownership change' across the six repos finds nothing for this feature (tried: tagg, hit.?list, deceased, ownership, weekly, dos). The term DOS is not implemented as an integration; DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. The nearest mechanism is the daily LTA/ROV result download (cron.ltadownload) that updates ownership for notices in processing, but that is not sending tagged vehicles/IDs to DOS and not weekly, so it is not counted. The 'Tagged Vehicle' page in ocmsadminui is only a commented-out Meta/menu entry with no pages/TaggedVehicle folder. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. No code for tagged vehicle/ID selection, weekly send to DOS, or ownership comparison. Ask URA to confirm whether DOS = DataHive/LTA and where this feature is built

steps.step: OCMS selects tagged vehicles and IDs for untraceable offenders with a certain life status
steps.detail: No query or job selects by life status or 'tagged' status. grep tagg, hit.?list, deceased, life.?status across ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, thirdpartyapi, ocmseserviceapi finds nothing for this feature. The 'Tagged Vehicle' menu is commented out (ocmsadminui/src/utils/data/LinkData.tsx:406, App.tsx:326-329) and there is no pages/TaggedVehicle folder.

steps.step: OCMS sends the tagged vehicle numbers and IDs to DOS every week
steps.detail: The prod cron list (cron-schedules-prod.properties) has no weekly job to DOS; the only weekly job is tempblobcleanup (lines 320-323). DOS does not exist as an integration in the backend; the only trace is the staff UI screen 'DOS Reports' with no controller (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/lists/ReportListDOS.tsx:82). DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS receives the latest vehicle ownership details from DOS
steps.detail: There is no receiver of a DOS file/response for tagged vehicles. The existing ownership mechanism is the LTA/ROV result download (cron.ltadownload.*, cron-schedules-prod.properties:148-149) for notices in processing, not for tagged vehicles and not from DOS, so it is not counted (consistency: a generic mechanism that exists but is not what the story names would be Sebagian at best, but source and trigger here are completely different). DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS compares the new data with the old to find out if ownership changed
steps.detail: No code compares old vs new ownership for tagged vehicles (grep ownership change / ownership in cronservice only finds LTA result processing and notice creation, not a change comparison for tagging). There is no ownership-change table or flag for tagging.
